purpose: Teach: 泣ける/競っ/上っ/臨む/抜粋/シーツ/出迎え/ハプニング

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新しいドラマ、泣ける話だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That new drama you told me about — it really got to me.
lines.style: Soft, vulnerable admission. Voice catches slightly on the memory. Warm gaze toward Aoi. Pace slows on the reveal of emotion. Traces of wonder that she felt something so deeply.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、コンテストで他店と競った結果、嬉しいよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And you beat out the other locations in that contest. I'm so happy for you.
lines.style: Bright, genuine pride in Aoi. Light emphasis on the accomplishment. Voice lifts naturally at the admission of happiness. Leans forward slightly — this matters to her. No irony, all warmth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お気に入りの曲が、チャートで上位に上ったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your favorite song made it to the top of the charts.
lines.style: Delighted like she discovered something she wanted to share. Quick pace, eager to watch Aoi's reaction. Small lift at the end — offering good news, not demanding a response. Genuine excitement for her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー発表に臨むのよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You're ready to unveil the new menu, aren't you?
lines.style: Encouraging, bracing Aoi for the moment ahead. Steady voice, clear and present. Slight rise at the end — affirmation more than question. Grounded, like she believes in this.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新聞の抜粋、お洒落だね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That piece in the newspaper — so elegant.
lines.style: Admiring murmur. Pause between phrases, letting each sink in. Voice soft with genuine appreciation. Eyes linger on Aoi as she speaks. No rush. Noticing what's real about her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の新しいシーツ、可愛いよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new linens at the café are beautiful.
lines.style: Casual warmth, like she noticed this small thing and wanted Aoi to know it was seen. Light, easy tone. Smile in the voice. Not a big deal, but proof she pays attention.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の出迎えはいつも丁寧ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The way you greet your customers — it's always so thoughtful.
lines.style: Earnest observation. Slight pause before 'thoughtful,' like she's finding the right word because it matters. Quiet wonder at Aoi's consistency. Voice settles, grounded. This is real noticing, not flattery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、ハプニングがあったお店、楽しかったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That unexpected thing that happened at the café yesterday — it made for a perfect memory.
lines.style: Wistful, happy recollection. Slow, warm pace. Voice lands softly on the memory, savoring it. Trailing warmth at the close. Like she's still holding the moment of them together.
